maps.name: D-Day: Normandy
maps.description: 6 June 1944 — cross the Channel from England, storm Utah–Sword, and break into Normandy. No German navy; the Atlantic Wall and 21st Panzer stand in your way. (One-shot)
maps.objective: Land the marine assault waves, capture a Normandy town and break inland.

maps.name: Kursk: Operation Citadel
maps.description: 5 July 1943 — hold the Kursk bulge. Model’s 9th Army comes down the Orel–Ponyri rail; Hoth’s 4th Panzer and Kempf come up from Belgorod toward Oboyan and Prokhorovka. (One-shot)
maps.objective: Defend both shoulders of the salient, then defeat the allied German armies.

maps.name: Midway
maps.description: 4 June 1942 — three American carriers at Point Luck, northeast of the atoll. Nagumo’s Kidō Butai is coming down from the northwest. Sink the Japanese carriers. (One-shot)
maps.objective: Keep the atoll supplied and defeat the approaching Japanese fleet.

maps.name: Thermopylae: The Hot Gates
maps.description: 480 BCE — Hold the coastal gate, watch the mountain trail, then take the Persian camps.
maps.objective: Hold the coastal gate, watch the mountain trail, then take the Persian camps.

maps.name: Hastings: Senlac Ridge
maps.description: 14 October 1066 — Break the shield wall on Senlac Ridge and secure the English rear.
maps.objective: Break the shield wall on Senlac Ridge and secure the English rear.

maps.name: Austerlitz: The Pratzen Heights
maps.description: 2 December 1805 — Cross the Goldbach, seize the Pratzen Heights and split the allied armies.
maps.objective: Cross the Goldbach, seize the Pratzen Heights and split the allied armies.

maps.name: El Alamein: Breakthrough
maps.description: 23 October 1942 — Open the northern corridor, break the defensive belts and capture El Daba.
maps.objective: Open the northern corridor, break the defensive belts and capture El Daba.
